mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zk_nyzkjg (zkxmid, yssj, yhsj, jssj, sybz, skbz) VALUES (#{zkxmid}, #{yssj}, #{yhsj}, #{resultDate}, #{sybz}, #{skbz})
INSERT INTO zk_nyzkjg (zkxmid, yssj, yhsj, jssj, sybz, skbz) VALUES (#{zkxmid}, #{yssj}, #{yhsj}, CURDATE(), #{sybz}, #{skbz})
mapper.select:
SELECT jg.id, jg.zkxmid, jg.yssj, jg.yhsj, jg.jssj, jg.sybz, jg.skbz, jg.jssj as syrq, x.zkpid, z.zkpmc, x.bz as target_bz, x.bzc as target_bzc, x.zkdz, x.zkgz, x.dx_lx, x.fhbz FROM zk_nyzkjg jg LEFT JOIN zk_nyzkxm x ON jg.zkxmid = x.zkxmid LEFT JOIN sys_zkpd z ON x.zkpid = z.zkpid WHERE 1=1
AND DATEDIFF(jg.jssj, #{begDate}) >= 0
AND DATEDIFF(jg.jssj, #{endDate}) <= 0
AND jg.jssj >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
AND x.zkpid = #{zkpid} AND jg.zkxmid = #{zkxmid} ORDER BY jg.jssj DESC

SELECT j.id, j.zkxmid, j.yssj, j.yhsj, j.jssj, j.sybz, j.skbz, x.xmid as xmdm FROM zk_nyzkjg j LEFT JOIN zk_nyzkxm x ON j.zkxmid = x.zkxmid WHERE 1=1 AND j.zkxmid = #{zkxmid}
AND DATEDIFF(j.jssj, #{begDate}) >= 0
AND DATEDIFF(j.jssj, #{endDate}) <= 0
AND j.sybz = 1 ORDER BY j.jssj DESC

SELECT j.id, j.zkxmid, j.yssj, j.yhsj, j.jssj, j.sybz, j.skbz, x.bz as target_bz, x.bzc as target_bzc, x.zkdz, x.zkgz, x.dx_lx FROM zk_nyzkjg j LEFT JOIN zk_nyzkxm x ON j.zkxmid = x.zkxmid WHERE j.zkxmid = #{zkxmid} AND j.sybz = 1 ORDER BY j.jssj DESC, j.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT x.zkpid, COALESCE(z.zwmc, z.zkpmc, CONCAT(COALESCE(z.sccj, ''), '质控品', x.zkpid)) as label, z.ph FROM zk_nyzkjg j LEFT JOIN zk_nyzkxm x ON j.zkxmid = x.zkxmid LEFT JOIN sys_zkpd z ON x.zkpid = z.zkpid WHERE j.yhsj IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x.zkpid
